name: 5x TVÄRDRAG 1.5W
measure_description: Measured manually with an IKEA GRILLPLATS Matter plug read through a Home Assistant power sensor (0.1 W resolution). The driver was set to 1-100 % brightness in 10 % steps and the stable power draw was noted at each step. Values below 1 W are coarse because of the meter resolution; brightness.csv lists the measured points and is interpolated between them. The profile covers the complete assembly: the ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-1 driver plus five TVÄRDRAG 1.5 W lamps.
